# Maintenance and troubleshooting

## 5.1 Routine maintenance

Document who is responsible for updating each product, how often updates are expected, and where source files and outputs are maintained.

## 5.2 Updating reporting periods and datasets

Explain which parameters, dates, input files, and reporting-period settings must be updated. Do not assume that all workflows use the same update procedure.

## 5.3 Package and software management

Record the tested R version, package dependencies, Quarto version, and any external software requirements. Keep this list aligned with the actual environment used by NMEP.

## 5.4 Quality assurance before release

- Confirm the reporting period and data source.
- Check completeness and validity of input data.
- Reconcile key indicators with approved source reports.
- Inspect tables, charts, maps, and narrative findings.
- Confirm that the final output opens correctly.
- Retain a dated copy of the released output and supporting scripts.

## 5.5 Troubleshooting

Add the actual errors encountered during testing and their verified solutions. Avoid listing untested fixes.

## Handover checklist

Use this section to record the responsible NMEP focal person, file locations, access requirements, update schedule, and outstanding issues for each product.
